ExtensionType.Label: Execute connector activity

ContextFields.Name: activityConfigurationVersion
ContextFields.Description: Marks the Integration Service activity format used by this template

ContextFields.Name: operation
ContextFields.Description: Activity catalog Name used as the runtime operation

ContextFields.Name: path
ContextFields.Description: Request path returned by resource metadata

ExtensionType.XmlTemplate:
<bpmn:sendTask id="{id}" name="{name}">
  <bpmn:extensionElements>
    <uipath:activity version="v1">
      <uipath:type value="Intsvc.ActivityExecution" version="v1" />
      <uipath:context>
        <uipath:input name="connectorKey" type="string" value="{connectorKey}" />
        <uipath:input name="connection" type="string" value="=bindings.{connectionBindingId}" />
        <uipath:input name="folderKey" type="string" value="=bindings.{folderBindingId}" />
        <uipath:input name="operation" type="string" value="{operation}" />
        <uipath:input name="objectName" type="string" value="{objectName}" />
        <uipath:input name="method" type="string" value="{method}" />
        <uipath:input name="path" type="string" value="{path}" />
        <uipath:input name="activityConfigurationVersion" type="string" value="v1" />
        <uipath:input name="metadata" type="json"><![CDATA[{}]]></uipath:input>
      </uipath:context>
      <uipath:output name="response" type="jsonSchema" source="=response" var="{varId}" />
    </uipath:activity>
  </bpmn:extensionElements>
  <bpmn:incoming>{incomingEdge}</bpmn:incoming>
  <bpmn:outgoing>{outgoingEdge}</bpmn:outgoing>
</bpmn:sendTask>
ExtensionType.DiscoveryNotes: Use `uip is activities list <connector-key> --output json` to select an activity. Set operation from Name, then describe ObjectName to get its current path, parameters, and fields.
ExtensionType.InputNotes: Add each request field from the selected operation as its own uipath:input. Keep the field's type and target: path, query, body, or file.
ExtensionType.ContextFieldNotes: connection points to a root binding for a Connection resource. When folder scoping is required, folderKey points to a second binding for the same resourceKey. Use propertyAttribute ConnectionId for connection and folderKey for folderKey. Omit folderKey when the selected activity has no folder scoping, and omit both fields only when it does not use a connection.
ExtensionType.ExtensionTagNotes: In isExecution array, NOT in isEvents array, so uses uipath:activity
